Name: Seed Samples
Author: deleted127110843
Description:
This mod adds various letters from Pierre, in which he will send you seeds in the mail. There are fourteen letters total, and twelve of them are repeatable.

[b]EDIT 1.0.5: [/b]Because of the limitations of Mail Framework Mod, in order to have it so that the repeatable letters don't appear [i]every [/i]day, I had to make it so that they can only be received on one day. Just check your mail whenever you have a new letter and you should be fine.

This mod is now i18n compatible and has a Korean translation thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92550688]Tubereuse[/url]!

Check out this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9805]Brazilian Portuguese[/url] translation of the mod!

Downloads.Description:
-When updating, make sure to check your mail every time you have a new letter! Otherwise you might miss out on seeds! This should fix the issue of letters repeating every day
-Minor typo fixes.
